issue_reference: Deliberately unset. The first pair of approach pilots pre-guessed issue numbers that GitHub then allocated to other work, and their frozen configs now carry stale references. The authoritative issue for this protocol is recorded in the registration pull request and in results/verification.json.
hypothesis: The 832 trainable opponent columns degrade the policy because they absorb temporal-difference error from the great majority of states in which no opponent is near enough to matter. Admitting only transitions whose start state has an opponent within eight tiles should leave the inherited policy closer to the reference while keeping the whole kill signal. The update schedule counts every post-warmup transition in both arms, so the arms perform essentially the same number of optimizer steps and the comparison isolates which experience supplies the gradient.

prior_evidence.issue_175: frozen inheritance preserves opponent-free behaviour exactly
prior_evidence.issue_178_and_update_cadence: one update per eight eligible transitions beat one per transition in the same direction on two hosts, without either run establishing the effect; the limit of that trend is zero updates, which is the reference
prior_evidence.update_cadence: both trained arms were worse than the unchanged reference on eliminations, score and collection with intervals excluding zero, and mean opponent distance rose against the reference in both arms: training teaches opponent avoidance
prior_evidence.approach_shaping: potential scale 1.0 removed that avoidance - control's gaps to the reference on eliminations and distance exclude zero while the shaped arm's do not - and scale 3.0 was harmful; scale 1.0 is therefore the fixed baseline in both arms here
prior_evidence.power: tripling hunting worlds from 40 to 120 moved the elimination interval width from 0.180 to 0.177 because the variance is between replicas, so these comparisons buy replicas instead of worlds

intervention.changed_factor: which transitions are admitted to replay
intervention.frozen_reference: all inherited columns, hidden layers, biases and outputs
intervention.baseline_shared_by_every_arm: frozen inheritance, #168 episode mixture, approach potential scale 1.0, one optimizer update per eight eligible transitions, native +5 kill reward
intervention.baseline_caveat: Potential scale 1.0 is the best configuration measured so far but was not itself established as better than the reference; it is a design choice, not an adopted default.
intervention.persistence: training-only; evaluation loads the unchanged archived agent

random_episode_schedule: All arms: for each five-episode block random.Random(agent_seed + 168000000 + block_index).randrange(5) selects one fully random episode; four greedy episodes.

uncertainty.method: hierarchical paired bootstrap over replicas and shared worlds
uncertainty.family: one test family per treatment arm that can be promoted; the promotion rule is conjunctive, so only the arm count is Bonferroni-adjusted
uncertainty.role: registered decision input, not a post-hoc description

selection: An arm is promotable only if every integrity gate, every retention gate and every efficacy gate passes. Among promotable arms the largest mean elimination gain over the unchanged reference is chosen, and within it the median-final replica by hunting eliminations. The best-looking replica is not selectable. If no arm is promotable the unchanged reference remains the incumbent and Task 3 closes with it as the selected artifact.
scientific_gates: Original cumulative Task 1/2/3 requirements are unchanged; this exploratory comparison cannot retrospectively establish Task 2 completion.
known_gate_defect: The zero-invalid-action gate counts the unchanged reference's own invalid actions, so no arm can pass it. It is retained unchanged here rather than relaxed mid-programme; a corrected specification belongs to a future protocol.

expected_disk_bytes.note: Measured 41 kB per retained episode directory and 3.4 MB for a final checkpoint once its replay buffer reaches capacity. Only final checkpoints are retained.

machine_allocation.training: 5 concurrent workers, one torch thread each
machine_allocation.latency: one worker on an otherwise idle machine; the only latency source

authorization: Owner 1BlauNitrox requested two further Task 3 comparisons on the night of 14 September 2026, one per host, to close Task 3 before moving to Task 4. One registered comparison per host, no automatic extension, no automatic promotion; the README and interpretation follow completed results.
